correctness.rationale: For any Hilbert embedding, group averaging preserves pairwise noncontraction and expansion bounds. Centered centroid identities and Cauchy-Schwarz force |b-c|<=a and (n-1)a<=(n-1)b+c. Three sharp algebraic lower certificates then bound the squared distortion, and explicit correlated regular-simplex coordinates attain the maximum of the three bounds in each full real interval. Exact-rational verification checks 1,756 cases and independent rational LP vertex enumeration checks 104 small cases; the infinite proof is analytical.

evidence: Cioaba et al., Theorem 4.3 and Section 4.2, prove c2 for every unweighted diameter-three distance-regular graph and therefore subsume the t=3 boundary. Their hypotheses use graph distance, not the continuously varied matched-pair distance t.

Vallentin, Theorem 2.4, gives lower bounds using distance-regular spectral data, applied in that paper to specific unweighted graph families. It does not evaluate the t-variable three-branch minimization.
The present proof needs three distinct lower certificates, including the threshold and plateau analysis over a real continuum.

value.rationale: The family connects complete-bipartite and crown graph metrics by a natural one-orbit antipodal deformation. The exact minimal Hilbert distortion has an unexpected nonzero-width plateau for every n>=3 with explicit pairwise parameter thresholds, and minimizing embeddings transition to antipodal simplices. This is a complete motivated infinite-family metric-embedding classification rather than a pointwise routine bound; endpoints and limits are stated without exaggeration.
